evals.prompt: Our billing dashboard already has working tables and KPI cards, but spacing and text contrast feel inconsistent. Polish the design to clean it up.
evals.expected_output: Treat as Polish tier: preserve existing information architecture, table layout, card structure, and navigation behavior. Fix alignment, padding cadence, typography hierarchy, and WCAG contrast. Do not rewrite layout geometry, rearrange data cards, or alter functional behavior without an explicit rethink request.

assertions.description: Categorizes scope under Polish default for existing designs
Preserves existing structural composition and navigation
Affirms decision to preserve existing structural components

evals.prompt: Restyle our checkout review page to match our updated brand palette and typography, but keep the current checkout flow and form structure intact.
evals.expected_output: Execute Restyle tier: update visual styling, brand colors, typography pairings, surface elevation, and corner radius while strictly preserving the checkout task flow, form field order, and layout structure. Do not initiate a structural rethink or dismantle form hierarchy without explicit human approval.

assertions.description: Preserves task flow and functional form layout
Requires explicit human approval before structural changes or rethink

evals.prompt: The current user settings page layout is okay, but I'm wondering if we should completely rethink and restructure the whole information architecture into tabs.
evals.expected_output: Flag that structural restructure requires explicit rethink scope and human approval because it dismantles existing layout and information architecture. Propose smallest effective change first, classify layout restructuring as Rethink requiring confirmation, and preserve current workflow constraints unless the user explicitly confirms the restructure.

assertions.description: Identifies structural reorganization as Rethink tier
Prioritizes smallest effective change and requires explicit direction before layout overhaul
Affirms decision that structural rethink requires human direction or approval
